blocks.text: BEIJING–Coco Gauff kept her composure to beat Camila Osorio 7-6 (7/4), 4-6, 6-2, at the China Open on Saturday, overcoming shaky serving to survive the second round. The Colombian, ranked 66th, put up a formidable fight after double-faulting to lose a testy first-set tie-break, though she needed medicine to push through trouble with her back. Osorio saved two match points but Gauff, the world number four, dug deep, rescuing long rallies with a solid backhand and cross-court saves. “It was tough, it wasn’t the cleanest,” said the 22-year-old American after the two-hour-and-18-minute match. “Just happy with how I was able to […]...
